posts.preview: It was an honour to meet and engage with various stakeholders over the past two months while Parliament was out conducting its oversight functions
I would like to sincerely thank all Members of Parliament, Parliamentary staff, and the various government agencies and their supporting teams for their tireless service to our people

One of the most eye-opening oversight activities was the assessment of compliance with labour legislation in the retail sector. The findings were very concerning and have highlighted the urgent need for us, as a country, to reflect and allocate adequate resources to the Ministry of Justice, Labour and Industrial Rel...

As I have been emphasising since last year, trade unions are strategic partners in any country’s economic development agenda. Treating them as useless organisations or according them less respect will only undermine labour relations and human development in our workplaces
